notes: The laptop; travels. Was the only vpn-jump until 2026-09-04. Disabled 2026-09-05 for the Tucson trip on a time-bound note that named 2026-09-08 as the re-enable date; RE-ENABLED 2026-09-09 against measurement rather than against that date alone — tailscale ping answers DIRECT via 192.168.10.190 (the home LAN, not a DERP relay, so the laptop is physically home) and ssh key auth returns LOKI/austi, exit 0. It was the only node here whose disabled state was time-bound rather than a standing gap, and as of 2026-09-15 it is the only node that has ever had one: the three machines this sentence used to contrast it against are all gone from it. pendragon was re-provisioned and enabled that day; surfacego and emerald were deleted from the tailnet by the operator and removed from this file with them. A standing gap is a claim about a machine, so it goes stale when the machine does — and the first correction here fixed only the pendragon clause and left the other two naming deleted boxes in the present tense, which an audit caught the same evening. If it travels again, flipping `enabled` here is the whole edit: since MCPs board task e447de72 it is declared in this file alone. The prior note said 'nothing else needs changing', which was wrong in exactly that way. GPU UNMEASURED: the gpu column was filled 2026-09-21 (board task 41f45bd7) from nvidia-smi and Win32_VideoController over ssh, and this node timed out on port 22 at 04:4xZ that day, so its row is null; the fleet audit of 2026-09-20T20:34Z had it UNREACHABLE too. Fill it from the node, not from fleet.json's gpu: null, which was written before this column existed and has never been measured either. DISABLED 2026-09-23 (board task ac147cde, A3) against measurement: tailscale status reads loki offline, last seen 6 days earlier (2026-09-17), rx 0; ssh over the Cloudflare path fails with 'websocket: bad handshake' because the loki-ssh tunnel has no live connector to hand the socket to (the hostname still answers 302 at the edge, so the tunnel record exists and the origin does not), and ssh over the tailnet times out on port 22. Both paths dead is a machine that is off or off every network, not a hub-side fault; every fleet tick had been failing on it since 2026-09-17. Re-enable on measurement, as on 2026-09-09: tailscale ping DIRECT and key auth returning LOKI/austi, and flip API/tools/fleet/fleet.json in the same act. RE-ENABLED 2026-10-03 (board task ef1db60e, the operator on 2026-10-02: 'pendragon is back on. and loki too') against that measurement, at 08:13Z: tailscale ping pongs DIRECT via 192.168.10.190:41641 in 3 ms, and ssh key auth answers Loki and loki\austi over both the Cloudflare path and the tailnet. Measured the same morning: 16 logical cores, 31.4 GB of RAM, 585.9 GB free of 932 GB on C:, an Intel Arc 140T and no CUDA device (so gpu stays null, now as a measurement), git, Python 3.11 and poetry present, powercfg /a offering network-connected Modern Standby, and cloudflared, csc_vpnagent, sshd and Tailscale all Automatic and Running. API/tools/fleet/fleet.json is flipped in the same act and keeps its budget (4 cores and 6 GB reserved for whoever is using it, 40 GB of disk), so loki gets a hub runner like sedona, the other vpn-jump. MADE THE SAME AS SEDONA 2026-10-09 (board task 28c43011): its Docker Desktop (4.53) was installed with the logon Run key but not running, so it was started in austi's desktop session and answered engine 29.0.1; API tools/fleet/scripts/install-windows-testdb.ps1 then unpacked the pinned PostgreSQL 16.15 client into C:\fleet\pgsql-16.15\bin and created corvis-fleet-testdb on 127.0.0.1:54904, so test_database is true here and in API/tools/fleet/fleet.json; choco's visualstudio2022buildtools with the VCTools workload gave vswhere VC tools 17.14.37710.0, sedona's and serendipity's version, which fleet.json declares as its cxx; and LongPathsEnabled, 0 here and on pendragon while 1 on sedona and serendipity, was set to 1. RESERVATION RAISED 2026-10-20 (MCPs board task 1e9ab738, decision 5eab8a7b): runners.json's windows_hosts declares four GitHub runners here (chat, corvis-stick, tree-bot, MCPs), each able to hold one job beside the dispatch lane, so the budget reserves 6 cores and 5.5 GB where it reserved 2 and 1.5: the operating system's 2 cores and 1.5 GB that MCPs board task e447de72 left here once the operator said no machine is used personally, plus a core and a GB for each runner, as lavender's budget reserves 8 cores beside its lane for its eight. The 4 cores and 6 GB for whoever is using it, above, is the 2026-10-03 budget e447de72 replaced. ELEVATED LANE 2026-10-20 (MCPs board task eff2d004): serendipity, the only node declaring elevated, went off ssh for its Linux conversion, and every MCPs proof waits for MCPs/execution-elevated (windows+elevated; the proof of 2ced95b7d queued job 2fa61fcf at 10:49:51Z with nothing able to claim it). This node is the Windows machine the operator keeps ('were going full linux. edcept loki'), and its ssh session holds the full token the lane needs, measured from diphtheria at 11:02:51Z: WindowsPrincipal.IsInRole(Administrator) True as loki\austi. So its dispatch declares elevated, and the hub runs its elevated lane here.
